connection: stdlib sqlite3; one connection per helper call in db.py
queries: Listings are fetched with a single JOIN over listings and shelters; pet detail is a single-row query
n_plus_one: No: listings already arrive from a single JOIN query
concurrency: single-process request loop, no shared state

optimization_targets.description: Keep listings joined with shelters in one query and avoid per-row lookups
Build response payloads straight from the fetched rows without issuing extra queries

notes: The listings endpoint returns up to 200 rows; the intended optimization is to preserve the single-query fetch while trimming the response payload.
